newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 363-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.07 percentage points to 1.61 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
Meanwhile, the 728-day Bondes rates fell 0.08 percentage points to 1.68 percent above the one-month rate.
The 363-day Bondex were assigned at 98.61764 pesos while the 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.50655 pesos.
Demand for the one-year Bondes was 1.91 billion pesos and 3.078 billion for two-year Bondes, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico for each term.
